org.name: Livelihood Development International Initiatives
org.promise: Empowering People. Strengthening Communities. Connecting the World.
org.address: 3701 Chesswood Drive, Unit 315, Toronto, ON M3J 2P6

mission: Livelihood Development International Initiatives is a nonprofit organization with a social enterprise committed to creating a brighter future that promotes social cohesion and human empowerment. We empower local and global communities to thrive amidst systemic crises through transformative leadership, development, innovative research, strategic partnership and human capital development that build resilience against global shocks.
